geography: Worldwide (Genzyme product revenue table, then Sanofi worldwide net sales line 'Myozyme / Lumizyme')
moa: Recombinant human acid alpha-glucosidase (GAA) enzyme replacement therapy
approval_note: Alglucosidase alfa was first approved in the US as Myozyme (BLA 125141, 04/28/2006); Lumizyme, the same active ingredient made at 4000 L scale, was approved under BLA 125291 on 05/24/2010 (Drugs@FDA: '05/24/2010 ORIG-1 Approval'). Genzyme and Sanofi report the two brands on one line (Myozyme, then 'Myozyme/Lumizyme').

launch_evidence.quote: due to continued growth in sales of Cerezyme, Fabrazyme and Thyrogen and the launch of Myozyme in the European Union and United States in the second quarter of 2006.

series_start_reason: Series starts at the 2006Q2 launch (EU and US approvals in the quarter). Genzyme's analyst schedule also prints small pre-approval amounts (Q4-05 1,532 and Q1-06 2,051 USD thousands, compassionate/expanded-access sales) which are not carried.
notes: Scope: worldwide net sales as the issuer prints them: USD thousands for Genzyme Corporation (2006Q2-2010Q4; line 'Myozyme', 'Myozyme enzyme', 'Myozyme/Lumizyme'), EUR million for Sanofi (2011Q2 on; line 'Myozyme / Lumizyme'). Values are not converted. Nexviazyme (avalglucosidase alfa), Sanofi's successor Pompe product, is printed on its own line and is not included.

unreported_quarters.2011Q1: Ownership change Genzyme to Sanofi; no full-quarter figure is published. Genzyme's last periodic report is the Form 10-K for 2010 (filed 2011-03-01); it filed no Form 10-Q or earnings release for the quarter ended March 31, 2011 (EDGAR list for CIK 732485 ends 2011-04-18). Sanofi consolidated Genzyme from April 1, 2011; its Q2 2011 release (filed 2011-07-28) is the first to print Genzyme net sales. A Sanofi Form 6-K of 2012-03-30 prints an unaudited Q1 2011 figure for the Genzyme products restated on Sanofi's basis for a period before Sanofi owned Genzyme; it is not used.

search_log: Sanofi quarterly results press releases: listed Sanofi (CIK 1121404) filings via data.sec.gov submissions (1,516 filings, 788 Form 6-K) and located releases with EDGAR full-text search restricted to CIK 1121404 for 'Lumizyme', 'Myozyme', 'Cablivi', 'Aldurazyme' and 'Admelog' (2011-2026); every Form 6-K HTML hit was fetched (116 documents) and parsed (bs4). One release per quarter (2011Q2-2026Q3) = the earliest-filed document with a net sales table headed 'Qn YYYY net sales' / 'Qn YYYY (€ million)'; the quarter is taken from the filing date (the Q2 2012 release prints the header 'Q2 2011 net sales' over Q2 2012 figures).

The product's row is read from the first table in the release whose header starts with the quarter column (headline net sales table; from 2016 the appendix table whose first column is the worldwide total), first figure = the quarter.

Genzyme Corporation (CIK 732485): listed filings via data.sec.gov submissions (1,535; last filing 2011-04-18); EDGAR full-text search restricted to CIK 732485 for 'Myozyme', 'Aldurazyme' and 'Mozobil' (10-Q, 10-K, 8-K); 113 HTML documents fetched and parsed.

Genzyme quarters 2007Q1-2010Q3 are the current-quarter column of the Forms 10-Q product revenue table; fourth quarters 2006-2010 are the last quarterly column (Q4-yy) of the analyst schedule in the February earnings release (Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1); 2006Q2 and 2006Q3 are the prior-year columns of the Q2 and Q3 2007 Forms 10-Q.
